items.difficulty_reason: Construction lemma (statement 1987-2000, proof 2002-2017): builds the canonical pushforward complex 0 -> a_*F -> a_{0,*}F_0 -> ... on D by a Yoneda reduction to the Hom complex, sourced from the chapter's simplicial resolution lemma via Hom(-, F) and adjointness; the two exactness statements follow from left exactness, resp. exactness, of Hom(-, F); no verification is omitted. H2: Yoneda bookkeeping over an established resolution.
